thread:
maya: thinking out loud — could we surface a tiny inspector overlay in route rows that shows per-model token burn + last-deployed-version? would help quick triage without opening the full route page

jon: love that. do you mean inline (hover) or a persistent pill?

maya: hover for noise reduction, but an optional pin to keep it visible. main thing is we need to show: model, pinned-version, avg-latency, token-avg (30m), telemetry-sample-rate.

alex: for telemetry-sample-rate, we should show the effective sampling (post-routing). otherwise people get confused when console numbers differ from raw traces.

maya: exactly. also a tiny hint for routing policy (e.g., fallback->gpt-x when dedicated exhausted). maybe a short blurb: "route: primary redwood-13b | fallback: open-7b"

sasha: API-wise, what's the cheapest shape? we could add a new light endpoint: GET /console/inspector?route_id=XYZ that returns a compact payload. sth like:

```json
{"route_id":"r_123","model":"redwood-13b","version":"v2","latency_ms":86,"tokens_avg":12.4,"sample_rate":0.15,"routing_policy":"dedicated->fallback"}
```

jon: that looks fine. one thing: we already have /routes/:id/summary which returns a bigger blob — will this be duplication?

maya: summary is heavy (policy history, configs). inspector should be intentionally tiny and cacheable for hover. TTL 10s and allow client-side invalidation on route update.

alex: caching on UI side is fine but we need to be careful with quota/units. if hover triggers N calls, we'll blow up. suggest batch endpoint with route_ids param so the list view can request 20 inspectors in one call.

sasha: batch endpoint is better. signature: GET /console/inspectors?route_ids=...&fields=model,latency,tokens,sample_rate

maya: +1. Also UX: show a telemetry badge with sample-rate tooltip that links to the route's telemetry-settings panel. small affordance: "sampled 15% — click to view traces"

jon: rollout concern: this will be visible in prod console quickly. we need a gating plan: feature flag by org, plus a rollout that starts on internal orgs. ops-bot: create feature flag?

ops-bot: created flag console.inspector_alpha, default: off for orgs. rollout target: internal-only first. flag id: ics_inspector_alpha_2026_03

maya: thanks. last thing — accessibility: keyboard focus should open the pinned inspector; hover-only won't be accessible. add a focus target and aria label for each inspector anchor.

alex: noted. I'll sketch the API PR and include batching and TTL controls. will link the PR here when ready.

jon: also add telemetry events: inspector_open, inspector_batch_fetch (size), inspector_pin. we can use these for cost/regressions.

maya: perfect. small follow-ups: 1) can we show 'last eval score' if available for the model-route pair? 2) include a tiny BETA tag when fallback policy differs from primary to make drift obvious.

alex: 1) last eval will be another field if present, empty otherwise. 2) BETA tag doable in UI only.

maya: great — thanks everyone. alex please drop the PR link when ready and assign for design review. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: PR checklist created: inspector-api + batching + feature-flag + telemetry. assignees: alex, sasha, maya.

jon: quick note — keep response size < 1kb per route for perf on mobile.

alex: will aim for ~200-400 bytes per route.

maya: thread resolved for planning purposes. will circle back in design review channel. :raised_hands:
